text:
Oliver Nguyen: Heads-up — sales needs a temporary rate bump for Acme onboarding load test. Customer will send ~3M tokens across 10k reqs over 12 hours. Can we grant per-key burst?
Kevin Park: Do we have any live ad-hoc flow today? I thought support only had manual DB toggle.
Oliver Nguyen: Right now support toggles the allowlist in the rate_limit_service DB and we patch the quota, but it's manual and no TTL/audit.
Sarah Li: This keeps coming up. Sales wants a 12–24h window with audit logs and an option in Console.
Josh Patel: Tech-wise we have two enforcement layers: per-key token bucket + org-level circuit. We could add a temporary 'elevation' record that overrides per-key limits, with expire_at and reason.
Kevin Park: Agreed. We need: 1) API to create elevation (admin-only), 2) TTL enforcement (atomic in limiter), 3) telemetry tag `elevation=true` for billing/alerts, 4) audit entry in events.
Oliver Nguyen: Can support call the API or should sales ask us? Sales prefers self-serve via Console UI.
Sarah Li: Console UX: a modal with fields: org, key, duration, reason, approver, link to contract. Defaults and guardrails. Need SSO check + 2FA for >24h.
Kevin Park: Minimal MVP: internal API + one-off web form for SRE/support, then Console later.
Josh Patel: Implementation sketch:
```
POST /admin/limits/elevate
{ "api_key": "ak_...", "delta_rps": 50, "delta_burst": 500, "expire_at": "2026-03-19T18:00:00Z", "reason": "onboarding load test", "requested_by": "support" }
```
Limiter will check elevation store before applying token bucket. Elevations should be replicated to all rate-limiters.
Kevin Park: Also add a rate to limit the number of concurrent elevations per org (avoid abuse).
Oliver Nguyen: Operational concerns: support needs a single endpoint to request and to revoke. Also a clear changelog sent to customer.
Sarah Li: OK prioritize: 1) internal API + support form (low-risk), 2) audit/logging + metrics (must), 3) Console flow (next quarter).
Kevin Park: Who owns the API? Eng-platform + Eng-infra for replication. Josh + I can ship MVP this sprint if no blockers.
Josh Patel: I’ll open a PR for the elevation store schema and the limiter hook. Will add tests for expire semantics.
Support Bot: Request 1775083321 created in internal-admin with TTL 12h — awaiting approver.
Oliver Nguyen: I'll keep sales updated. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: infra/limits-service: elevation-store migration deployed to staging.
Kevin Park: Follow-up: we must make sure billing tags flow all the way to billing pipeline so we can attribute costs.
Sarah Li: Noted, tagging is in scope for MVP.
Oliver Nguyen: Closing loop — sales confirmed the customer will start next Tuesday. We'll coordinate timing after staging runs.
